events.title: Certiorari Denied in Zakrzewski v. Florida
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States denied the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Edward J. Zakrzewski v. Florida. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of the death sentence will proceed as scheduled, and the Court will not review the case.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.

events.title: Supplemental Briefs Ordered in Louisiana v. Callais
events.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered the parties in the cases of Louisiana v. Callais, Phillip, et al. and Robinson, Press, et al. v. Callais, Phillip, et al. to file supplemental briefs. The briefs must address whether the State of Louisiana's intentional creation of a second majority-minority congressional district violates the Fourteenth or Fifteenth Amendments to the U.S. Constitution. The deadlines for the supplemental briefs are set for August 27, 2025, for appellants, September 17, 2025, for appellees, and October 3, 2025, for reply briefs.
events.why_relevant: The order addresses potential constitutional violations in the creation of congressional districts, impacting representation and voting rights.
